title: Fix some spelling errors in dissector strings.
description:
A first batch of spelling errors, detected using a script that uses
pyspellcheck and a Wireshark-specific dictionary file.

notes.body: There will be a second batch of these.  I can clean up and submit the script if it makes sense to.

commits_data.title: Fix some spelling errors in dissector strings.
commits_data.message:
Fix some spelling errors in dissector strings.

A first batch of spelling errors, detected using a script that uses
pyspellcheck and a Wireshark-specific dictionary file.
